<!-- Building or changing a pack? See CONTRIBUTING.md and skills/runpapers-builder/SKILL.md. -->
- [ ] `rp lint <DOI>` passes and `rp verify <DOI>` meets every required target (the checks below run this too)
- [ ] Every expected value in targets.toml is the paper's own number, with its source (main text, figure or table)
- [ ] Data are downloaded from the original repository (no re-hosting), with sizes and checksums and their terms in pack.toml
- [ ] No published figure images, tokens, personal paths or e-mail addresses are added
